equilibrium_warning: pseudo-OCP: extracted from a ~C/50 galvanostatic p-OCV with rests only at the branch endpoints. The curve therefore contains the C/50 polarisation (lithiation branch biased low, delithiation branch biased high) and is NOT a true equilibrium OCP. Using it as the model OCP double-counts that polarisation, so the replay residual is a conservative (pessimistic) estimate. Not a material constant: it is the measured quasi-equilibrium response of this electrode at the declared room temperature.
